storage.description: Your match archives stay on this PC. Past the limit, the oldest are removed; their figures stay.
storage.capacity_one: About {{count, number}} match fits in this limit.
storage.capacity_other: About {{count, number}} matches fit in this limit.
storage.protected: The archives of your last 90 days and of your last 40 matches are never removed.

confirm.title: Lower the limit?
confirm.body_one: About {{count, number}} archive older than 90 days will be removed ({{size}}). Its figures stay, but its timeline, damage and players will not come back.
confirm.body_other: About {{count, number}} archives older than 90 days will be removed ({{size}}). Their figures stay, but their timeline, damage and players will not come back.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: The log helps understand a problem. It never holds your account id.
diagnostics.debugHint: Adds the debug lines to the log. Turn it on only to look into a problem.
diagnostics.openFailed: The log folder could not be opened.

about.title: About
about.licence: Free software under the MIT licence.
about.valve: TheLibrary is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve.
about.privacy: Your data stays on this PC. The app only contacts deadlock-api (match data and images), Steam (to link your account) and GitHub (to look for a new version at startup).
about.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
about.notices: The licences of the software TheLibrary includes are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, in the repository and with every release.

link.title: Link your Steam account
link.explanation: Steam's sign-in page opens in your browser. Steam will show the site as 127.0.0.1: that is TheLibrary on this PC. TheLibrary never sees your password.
link.waiting: Waiting for Steam in your browser…

outcome.refused: Steam did not confirm this sign-in. Try again.
outcome.steam_unavailable: Steam is unavailable right now. Try again later.

switch.warning: Linking another account deletes all the data of {{name}} on this PC: its matches, archived details and history.

unlink.title: Unlink {{name}}?
unlink.warning: All their data on this PC will be deleted: matches, archived details and history. This cannot be undone.
unlink.incomplete: Some files could not be removed yet; TheLibrary will finish at its next start.

kind.forbidden: Access was denied by the data service.
kind.invalid_payload: The data service returned unexpected data.
kind.storage: Local data could not be read or saved.
